description: 【名古屋市】被災者支援策一覧表(災害救助法が適用されない場合) [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 地震や台風等の災害で被災された方々への支援として、名古屋市で設けている被災者支援制度を一覧としてまとめています。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are 名古屋市, 災害, 災害救助, 被災者支援策, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-11-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
